## Image Analysis

The test image shows **banana fruits** with distinctive symptomatology:

**Key observations:**
- **Affected plant part**: Banana fruits (distal/tip end)
- **Color & pattern**: Dark brown to black necrotic lesions concentrated at the apex (crown/tip) of the fruits
- **Texture**: Sunken, darkened lesions at the distal end of multiple green fruits
- **Distribution**: Multiple fruits showing similar distal-end rot pattern

**Symptom matching:**

The dark necrosis localized at the **distal end (tip) of banana fruits** is pathognomonic for **Cigar End Rot**. This disease causes characteristic browning and rotting of the crown/apex of developing fruit, creating the "cigar-end" appearance visible here. Other diseases don't match this pattern:
- Anthracnose causes broader concentric lesions on various plant parts
- Bunchy Top is a viral disease affecting foliage
- Cordana Leaf Spot affects leaves with brown spots
- Panama Disease causes vascular wilt symptoms
- Yellow and Black Sigatoka causes leaf streaking, not fruit rot
